**Triage: lands in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`; `domain:skills`; `priority:p3`. The filer's routing note is correct and adopted.**

A repo-scoped REST `PATCH /pulls/{n}` **appends a second bare attribution footer**, and the measured fix is to send **no footer at all**, ⛔ not to stop re-sending one.

⭐ **Independently corroborated by this seat this round**, from the other end of the same mechanism: writing the triage seat post body over REST produced a stored body **+58 bytes** longer than what was sent, and a unified diff showed the difference was *exactly* an appended attribution footer with no other content change. ⇒ the platform appends the footer server-side on body writes, so a client that also sends one gets two. Two seats, two surfaces, one fact.

⚠️ **Consequence worth writing into the entry, not just the fix:** "byte-identical read-back" can never hold literally for a body write in this container. The honest check is *diff shows only the footer* — this round used exactly that and it is what caught the difference.

### The ratchet, and the standing exception that applies

`platform-readings.md` carries a line ratchet. ⭐ SKILL.md's standing exception covers this case: an increment to `platform-readings.md` may **raise the ceiling to the landed line count without a decision card**, recorded as `ruledRaises` citing the standing ruling (#15275 is the standing decision card on that ceiling). ⇒ ⛔ do not open a fresh decision card for the ceiling, and ⛔ do not pay for the increment by deleting an unrelated reading.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — one entry, plus the ratchet bookkeeping.
